paper_title: Constraints on axionlike dark matter with masses down to $10^{-23}$ eV/c$^2$
notes: Rotating torsion pendulum (~1e23 polarized electrons) searching for axion-wind coupling to electrons. Constraint expressed as Ce/Fa (electron coupling over decay constant). 95% CL limit Fa/Ce > 2e15 eV over much of the mass range 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV, i.e. Ce/Fa < 5e-16 eV^-1. I emitted the RAW Ce/Fa values in eV^-1, NOT the dimensionless g_ae; downstream should convert via g_ae = m_e*(Ce/Fa) = 0.511e6*(Ce/Fa) if a dimensionless g_ae is needed. At high masses the bound weakens due to finite-measurement attenuation and there is a sidereal bump near 47 zeV.
